messages.body:
**13. Asynchronous hop 4: the page (and the order page) poll the order**

The checkout learns about the payment by polling `GET /api/orders/{id}` every 3 s (web/src/checkout/waitForPayment.ts:8), showing the server's message when it changes, and returns on paid, failed or cancelled. The order page does the same with a 3 s refetch (web/src/api/orders.ts:6). Watch out: the page gives up after 10 minutes (web/src/checkout/Checkout.vue:17) while the worker allows a charge 20 (step 7). When the page gives up first, the order keeps going on the server; the message says so (:34).
